entries.text: 洛托洛托洛托洛托……
entries.label: team_0020_system_01

entries.text: 天星队的基地就在附近。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_02

entries.text: 既然你都到这里来了，\n也就是说……你愿意帮忙吧？[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_03

entries.text: 是的
entries.label: team_0020_select_01

entries.text: 迫不得已
entries.label: team_0020_select_02

entries.text: 谢谢。这样一来，\n你也成了我们的同伴……[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_04

entries.text: 实行星尘大作战的成员！[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_05

entries.text: 哎，那件事……\n能不能让我也掺和进来？[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_02

entries.text: 我是聂凯。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_03

entries.text: 你什么时候开始偷听的？[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_07

entries.text: 哎哎，用不着那么戒备我。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_04

entries.text: 我和这家伙是一伙的。\n对吧？[VAR 0x0100(0000)]？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_05

entries.text: 是吗……？
entries.label: team_0020_select_03

entries.text: 不对！
entries.label: team_0020_select_04

entries.text: 我说！你这家伙\n总是这么腼腆啊！[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_06

entries.text: 对手是天星队。\n这可不是闹着玩的哦。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_08

entries.text: 我知道……\n我跟天星队也有不少恩怨的。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_07

entries.text: 虽然这样说有点自吹自擂，\n但我办事很到位的哦。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_08

entries.text: …………\c\n现在人手不足，喵喵的手也能来凑。\n欢迎你成为我们的同伴。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_09

entries.text: 就这么定了。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_09

entries.text: 你叫仙后对吧？\n话说你到底是什么来头？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_10

entries.text: 我仙后是\n天星队的前……\r\n不，你只要知道我是相关人员就行了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_10

entries.text: ……这样啊。\n那我就不细问了。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_11

entries.text: ……那么，我马上来\n说明一下星尘大作战吧。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_11

entries.text: 具体要做什么？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_12

entries.text: 简单地说，\n就是要进入天星队的基地。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_12

entries.text: 打倒率领小队的老大……\n让他们通通下台！[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_13

entries.text: 下台……？\n是说要让他们引退吗？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_13

entries.text: 是的……天星队\n一共有５个小队，\r\n每个小队都有各自的基地。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_14

entries.text: 这附近应该能看到一个门。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_15

entries.text: 穿过去之后就是天星队的基地。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_16

entries.text: 我们的目标——小队的老大\n应该就在深处。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_17

entries.text: 天星队有个规矩。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_18

entries.text: 只要有人挑战老大，\n老大就必须接受挑战。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_19

entries.text: 而且……\n老大接受挑战后一旦输了，\r\n就必须要引退。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_20

entries.text: 我刚才已经在各个基地\n以[VAR 0x0100(0000)]的名义宣战了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_21

entries.text: 也就是说，我们已经\n向天星队发起挑战了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_22

entries.text: 只要打倒老大，\n让老大引退……[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_16

entries.text: [EMPTY 66]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_23

entries.text: 小队在老大引退之后，\n应该就会群龙无首，溃不成军。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_24

entries.text: [EMPTY 66]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_17

entries.text: 不过，也有个问题。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_25

entries.text: 基地里到处徘徊着\n阻止外人入侵的宝可梦。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_26

entries.text: 以一般训练家的实力，\n很难到达老大所在的地方。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_27

entries.text: [EMPTY 66]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_29

entries.text: [EMPTY 66]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_30

entries.text: 打倒基地内的宝可梦，\n把老大逼出来吧。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_31

entries.text: ……不过，得先进入基地才行。\n你去解决看门的吧。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_32

entries.text: 你负责什么？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_18

entries.text: ……就像刚才说的一样，\n我以前是天星队的相关人员。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_33

entries.text: 不能公开地行动……\n让我在远处支援吧。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_34

entries.text: 有什么我能做的事吗？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_19

entries.text:
抱歉，我还没办法
完全信任你……\c
拜托你监视基地周围
并协助[VAR 0x0100(0000)]吧。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_35

entries.text: ……我倒是不讨厌谨慎的人。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_20

entries.text: 作战开始后我会联系你的。\n祝你武运昌隆。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_36

entries.text: 校长……？
entries.label: team_0020_select_05

entries.text: 那个……
entries.label: team_0020_select_06

entries.text: 哟，拜托你封住自己的嘴，\n不要说出我的真实身份哦。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_22

entries.text: 我现在是聂凯……\n你就当是这么一回事吧。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_23
